physical_description.posture_movement: Moves fast and low â€” economy of motion learned young. Always aware of exits and sightlines; tends to position himself at angles to walls. When nervous, he laughs too quickly and deflects with self-deprecation. Despite the outward confidence of gang affiliation, his body language reads as coiled tension rather than relaxation.

Base layer is a fitted compression underlayer (usually dark gray or black, visible at wrists and collar). Two hooded shells in muted colors â€” charcoal, slate, worn navy â€” worn open and loose for quick shedding. Boots are scuffed and practical, broken in but not expensive. A thick canvas jacket with faded gang markings on the interior lining. Everything smells faintly of market grime and industrial coolant. No jewelry except a thin brass ring on his left index finger (his grandmother's, a secret talisman he never mentions).
